auditConfig.//: Issue #29: pnpm audit --prod --audit-level high is a HARD gate (ci.yml). These GHSAs are the exception, not a blanket ignore: each is a TRANSITIVE advisory that no change in this repo can resolve, so blocking on them would make the gate permanently red for reasons a contributor cannot act on (the automatised-pipeline #77 lesson). The one high advisory that WAS fixable in-diff — mathjs — is fixed (bumped to ^15.2.0), not ignored. Re-audit and remove entries when upstream publishes fixes: ajv (fast-uri) and @modelcontextprotocol/sdk (hono, js-yaml).
